lore: Hides behind a woven basket shield. Break the basket, then the vendor.
mechanism: Shield tank: a Hungry Ghost with an 80 HP body behind a 120 HP basket shield. While the shield holds, damage drains it first (overflow spills to the body) and the vendor trudges at 0.5 m/s. When it breaks the baskets drop off (visual tween) and the vendor speeds up to 0.9 m/s. Weak bites (8 per 0.6 s). All march/seek/eat/siege AI, health bar and materials inherited.
name: Street Vendor
